mentions.name: pagebowl
mentions.description: A lightweight service for instantly hosting HTML, Markdown, and ZIP-based static pages. Users upload a file, get a live link, and pages expire automatically. It targets making it easy to share AI-generated files by rendering and hosting them for a short period of time.
mentions.problem: Sharing AI-generated files is cumbersome; users need a simple place to render and host them for a short period of time.
mentions.audience: Users looking to share AI-generated files easily
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building pagebowl: 
https://www.pagebowl.com/

A lightweight service for instantly hosting HTML, Markdown, and ZIP-based static pages. The goal is to make sharing simple: upload a file, get a live link, and let it expire automatically.
